name: Release Checklist
description: A per-issue definition-of-done checklist. The team edits the items once in plugin settings; every issue gets its own state, and completing the list posts a sign-off comment.

items.label: Checklist items
items.description: One per line. Shared by the whole workspace.
items.placeholder:
Tests pass
Docs updated
Migration reviewed

signoff_template.label: Sign-off comment
signoff_template.description: Posted when every item is checked. {{items}} expands to the completed list.

strict.label: Require sign-off before posting
strict.description: When on, the comment is only offered once every item is checked.
